user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Alien Jungle Ruins. An alien jungle at twilight: bioluminescent flora in impossible colors, coiled fern-spirals, gas-filled floating spore sacs, a ruined obelisk of unknown geometry etched with glowing glyphs, hanging vine curtains, a shallow iridescent pool, small drifting jellyfish-like fliers, and a ringed gas giant looming through the canopy gaps. Style: exotic xeno-fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
